itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.title: What is photosynthesis? | Live Science
itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.snippet: Photosynthesis is the process used by plants, algae and some bacteria to turn sunlight into energy. The process chemically converts carbon dioxide (CO2) and water into food (sugars) and oxygen. The chemical reaction often relies on a pigment called chlorophyll, which gives plants their green color.
